title: Refute cnf lemmas over rewritten ites with z3-found theory clauses
summary: When both propositional searches fail on a cnf lemma, the Lean reconstructor now asks z3 for theory clauses over the lemma's leaves and proves each one in Lean before retrying the refutation. The QF_LRA tta_startup 11-node benchmark, a known failure since iteration 45, now verifies.
